cards.title: Why is a child saying 'Na-na, na-na-na!' annoying?
cards.body: Explore why repetitive sounds from children can test parental patience. This reader-answered column tackles common parenting frustrations and their explanations.

cards.title: Partner's behavior at kids' football matches straining relationship
cards.body: A parent seeks advice after 25 years together as their partner's inappropriate conduct at their sons' matches is becoming problematic. The advice column explores how to address anger and behavior issues affecting family time.

cards.title: Who invented emojis? Kids' quiz and brain teasers
cards.body: A fun quiz designed by children with five multiple-choice questions to test knowledge. Parents can also submit their own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: Halloween magic: ditching cynicism for family connection
cards.body: A parent embraces Halloween celebrations as an opportunity for magic and connection with their children. Exploring traditions from Day of the Dead to Samhain creates meaningful autumn moments.

cards.title: Working parents face school holiday logistical nightmare
cards.body: Managing school holidays while working full-time creates constant life admin challenges for parents. The article advocates for systemic changes to help working parents enjoy undistracked time with their children.

cards.title: Behavioral approaches work for neurodivergent kids too
cards.body: Contrary to common parenting advice, rigorous trials show behavioral approaches are effective for neurodivergent children, including autistic kids. Evidence-based strategies can help with everyday demands and challenges.

cards.title: Beyond 'make this go away': kids and mental health
cards.body: Creating a safe space for children's emotional lives teaches them essential mental health skills. Parents who normalize discussing feelings help kids develop the resilience to manage their inner worlds.

cards.title: Mothers with their own needs face harsh judgment
cards.body: Mothers continue facing societal criticism for prioritizing their own wellbeing and personal care. Addressing this stigma is crucial for parental mental health and modeling healthy boundaries for children.

cards.title: Could you spot cancer symptoms in children?
cards.body: Although rare, cancer is the leading cause of death from disease among UK children under 15. Early recognition of symptoms can be lifesaving for parents and caregivers.

cards.title: Paternal regret: becoming the father you aspire to be
cards.body: Paternal regret extends beyond children's hurt to how fathers may have hurt themselves. This reflection offers fathers another chance to become the men and parents they still aspire to be.
